opencode.title: OpenCode
opencode.subtitle: Optional MIT coding-engine sidecar. Chat delegates a task; the live TUI opens in the conversation terminal.
opencode.empty: OpenCode is not ready. Install the CLI, then ask the agent to call opencode_status.
opencode.server.stopped: Not started until a session opens
opencode.help: Install: curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash — or npm i -g opencode-ai. Set EYAS_OPENCODE_BIN if it is not on PATH.
opencode.check.cli.label: OpenCode CLI
opencode.check.version.label: OpenCode version
opencode.check.pty.label: POSIX PTY
opencode.check.attach.label: Server
opencode.check.attach.detailSpawn: EYAS starts its own password-protected OpenCode server on 127.0.0.1 when a session starts.
opencode.check.attach.detailExternal: Attached to an external OpenCode server ({{url}}). EYAS does not start or isolate it: its own config, sign-in and permission rules apply.
opencode.check.isolation.label: Isolation
opencode.check.isolation.detail: EYAS owns the OpenCode config, data, state and cache. Host Claude Code instructions and skills, other assistants' skills and project config are not loaded. Headless tasks ask the EYAS security gate before every tool call.
opencode.check.isolation.detailExternal: Not isolated: an external server uses its own configuration and memory, not the EYAS-owned OpenCode home.
opencode.signIn.hint: OpenCode in EYAS has its own sign-in, separate from your everyday OpenCode. Sign in once in the OpenCode terminal of a conversation with /connect.
opencode.settings.title: Model and reasoning
opencode.settings.hint: Tasks the assistant hands to OpenCode (opencode_run) use this model and reasoning variant. Empty uses OpenCode's own default. The OpenCode terminal keeps its own model picker.
opencode.settings.serverNotRunning: The model list comes from the running OpenCode server, which starts with the first OpenCode session or task. Until then only the saved choice is shown.
opencode.settings.modelsUnavailable: Could not read the model list from OpenCode.
